name: bada-vm-pro
description: BadaVM Pro — a quantum hypervisor written in the Bada language: install BadaOS (NetBSD-style base + Ubuntu-style command line; vim/emacs/sshd/xinetd preinstalled; internet over the NAT; su/sudo user switching; the zone:// ultra-network WWW with ZoneBrowser and the MigemoInsta migemo-searchable photo feed as in-guest X clients; LILO in the MBR with a GRUB menu) and display its X clients on the bundled BadaX Server (an ASTEC-X style X server for Windows). Unofficial educational homage; self-contained HTML app.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
